Accordion: Expandable sections that reveal content when their titles are triggered.
ActivityItem: An event with author, time, content and context. Molecule shared by the feed and the compact version of ActivityTimeline.
AlertDialog: Confirmation of an important action, with explicit confirm or cancel options.
AppShell: Application structure combining side navigation, top bar and content area.
ApprovalWorkbench: Reusable review area, with information, progress and decision actions.
AspectRatio: Container that keeps the aspect ratio of images, videos and other media.
Avatar: Visual identity of a person or entity, by image or initials.
AvatarGroup: Stack of avatars with a visible limit, overlap and a count of extra participants.
Badge: Compact label to convey category, quantity or state.
BillingCard: Billing summary and payment method, with actions provided by the application.
BrandLogo: Refy wordmark and symbol with sizes and display variants.
Breadcrumb: Hierarchical navigation path, showing the current page.
Bubble: Bubble that shows a piece of a conversation and identifies its source.
Button: An action triggered by mouse, touch or keyboard, with progress and result states.
ButtonGroup: Grouping of related controls; selection and events belong to the child components.
Calendar: Calendar to pick a date or a range, with limits and navigation between months.
Callout: Contextual message with a semantic tone, content and optional actions.
Card: Content surface with spacing, header and elevation levels.
Carousel: Sequence of navigable content, with position indicator and forward controls.
Charts: D3 charts: cartesian, radial, statistical, hierarchical, networks, flows and maps; accessible legends, axes, tooltip and data.
Checkbox: Independent choice, with label, description and selected or disabled states.
Chip: Filter or selection tag, with semantic tone and optional removal.
ChoiceCard: Choice shown in a card, with single or multiple selection and explanatory content.
CodeBlock: Code with syntax colors, monospaced font and copy of the original content.
Collapsible: Area that toggles content visibility through an expand control.
Combobox: Search field and selection of one option, with keyboard navigation.
Command: Command palette with search, groups and shortcuts to run app actions.
ConnectorCard: State of a connection or integration, with options to connect, manage or remove.
ContextMenu: Context menu triggered on a specific area or item.
Coverflow: Finite browsing of visual content with selection by identity, navigation, gesture and explicit activation.
DangerZone: Area for sensitive actions, with explanation and callbacks; the application provides the confirmation before running.
DatePicker: Date selection by button and calendar, with clearing; no free typing.
DeviceFrame: Browser or phone frame with the live page at the device's real width.
Direction: Container that sets the reading direction, left to right or reversed.
Divider: Visual separation between content groups, with optional orientation and label.
Drawer: Side or bottom panel for content and actions related to the current context.
EmptyState: Empty state that explains the situation and offers a next action when it applies.
EventTimeline: Activity history grouped by date: author next to content, context and actions. ActivityTimeline also builds compact widgets. EventTimeline is a compatibility alias. For milestones of a journey, use Timeline.
Fab: Main floating action, compact or with a label.
FabMenu: Floating action that reveals a set of related actions.
FileUpload: File selection and preview, with validation, progress and removal.
GeoAreaPicker: Select an area by radius or regions, with optional map integration.
GoogleButton: Google sign-in action, keeping the provider's identity and the control's states.
GuidedTour: Sequence of guidance anchored to interface elements.
HelpField: Help tied to a field, with an explanation and optional deeper detail.
HelpMenu: Menu of help resources, documentation and support.
Hero: A page's first fold with title, accent, lead and actions; the composition comes from the theme.
HoverCard: Extra information revealed on hover or focus of an element.
IconButton: Compact action shown as an icon, with a required accessible name.
Input: Text input with label, help, prefixes and error messaging.
IntentComposer: Composing a request, with suggestions and processing states.
Item: Content row with title, description, visuals and optional action.
KanbanBoard: Board with global or per-stage WIP, per-column colors and transition rules. Drag by the handle or use keyboard/menu. Column and toolbar actions are composition, with no built-in business rules.
KanbanCard: Work card with composed opening, metadata and actions. The same molecule is used in the column and in the KanbanBoard drag preview.
Kbd: Visual representation of a key or shortcut combination.
Label: Form label tied to a control by the htmlFor attribute.
Marker: Marking a piece of text with the theme's colors and shape.
Matrix2x2: Points distributed in four quadrants, with axes, labels and selection.
Menu: Contextual list of actions, separators and labels, with keyboard navigation; no nested submenus.
Menubar: Bar of related menus, with options organized by purpose.
Message: Conversation message with identity, content, time and optional actions.
MessageScroller: Message area with scrolling and access to the latest messages.
Modal: Dialog over the interface, with title, content, actions and focus management.
Multiselect: Search and selection of multiple options, showing and removing the choices.
NavCard: Navigation destination shown as an actionable card.
NavigationMenu: Main navigation with groups and supporting content.
NotificationBell: Access to notifications, with the unread count and read actions.
OAuthButton: Sign-in buttons for Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Spotify, GitHub, X, Apple and Microsoft. They compose Button/GoogleButton; the application implements the OAuth flow.
Otp: Verification code input, with multiple slots and paste support.
PageHeader: Page header with title, description, path and contextual actions.
Pagination: Navigation between result pages, with current position and bounds.
PersonCell: Identification of a person or entity for rows, lists and tables.
PhoneInput: Phone input with country selection, international code and formatting.
PlanCard: Comparable presentation of a plan, with features, price and a choose action.
Popover: Contextual content anchored to a control, with controllable open and close.
PostalCodeInput: Postal code (CEP) input and lookup, with searching, result and error states.
ProgressBar: Progress of a task or usage of a quota, with tone and loading state.
PropertyActionGroup: Related decision actions, with processing, done and unavailable states.
PropertyCard: Content card with media, information and actions, in different compositions.
PropertyMedia: Media display with aspect ratios, navigation and loading or error states.
Prose: Typography for editorial content, including headings, paragraphs, lists, links and tables.
Questionnaire: A sequence of questions with answer selection, navigation and completion.
RadioGroup: Set of mutually exclusive alternatives, with labels and descriptions.
Range: Selection of a numeric range with two bounds and keyboard support.
Resizable: Split of an area into resizable panels.
ScoreGauge: Score indicator with bands, label and size variations.
ScrollArea: Area with limited height and its own scrolling, keyboard accessible.
Section: Page block with text and proof side by side, stacked or in the theme's columns.
SectionHeader: Section title with count, description and optional action.
Segmented: Choice between related alternatives shown in a segmented control.
Select: Native selection of one option, with groups, label and help.
SettingRow: Settings row with description, state and an associated action or control.
SettingsSubnav: Navigation between settings areas, with groups and the current section marked.
Sidebar: The app's side navigation, with expanded, compact and collapsed versions.
SiteFooter: Site footer with brand, link columns and credits.
Skeleton: Temporary visual structure that stands in for the content while it loads.
Slider: Pick a numeric value by dragging, track or keyboard.
Snackbar: Result message with an optional contextual action; position and duration are set by the app.
Spinner: Visual indicator of an operation in progress.
SplitButton: Main action paired with a menu of alternative actions.
Stat: Display of a value with optional label, change and trend.
StatusDot: Compact signal of a state, with label and activity indicator.
StickyBar: Action bar tied to the context, kept during scrolling.
StickyFooter: Persistent footer with actions and information provided by the application; does not validate forms.
SwipeDeck: Sequence of decision cards with navigation, gestures and explicit actions.
Switch: Toggle of a preference between on and off.
Table: Data table with search, filters, sorting, pagination and content states.
TableOfContents: Anchor table of contents that follows the visible section of a document.
Tabs: Related content organized in tabs with keyboard navigation.
Textarea: Multi-line text input with label, help and error.
Timeline: Milestones of a journey with dates and a time axis. Alternating vertical or horizontal, with optional media and actions. For events by people and systems, use ActivityTimeline.
Toast: Result notice with configurable action, dismissal and duration.
ToggleGroup: A set of independent toggles with multiple values; for exclusive choice, use Segmented or RadioGroup.
Tooltip: Short explanation of a control, shown on focus or hover.
Topbar: Top bar with path, search, tabs or segments and slots for actions; notifications, help and account are compositions by the consumer.
Trace: Expandable sequence of steps to show an operation's progress.
UsageMeter: Resource usage against a limit, with a value and a visual state.
UserMenu: Account menu with identity and actions provided by the application.
VisitSchedulePicker: Selection of available days and times, with summary and time zone.
VoiceRecorder: Controlled interface for recording, pause, error and a text alternative; capture, permissions and transcription are wired by the app.
WizardStepper: The steps of a flow, with current, done and pending states.
WorkspaceSwitcher: Selecting and searching a workspace, with management actions.
